Teacher.title: Teacher
Teacher.description: Represents a teacher using the ProZil app.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Teacher entity (Firebase Auth UID).

prozilId.description: Public, user-friendly identifier for the teacher, in the format <name>-<6_digits>.

lastSeen.description: Timestamp of the last time the user was active in the app.

deletedAt.description: Timestamp when the user was soft-deleted. If present, the user is considered archived.

Student.title: Student
Student.description: Represents a student using the ProZil app.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Student entity (Firebase Auth UID).

prozilId.description: Public, user-friendly identifier for the student, in the format <name>-<6_digits>.

teacherIds.description: A list of Auth UIDs of the teachers linked to this student. (Relationship: Teacher N:M Student)

lastSeen.description: Timestamp of the last time the user was active in the app.

deletedAt.description: Timestamp when the user was soft-deleted. If present, the user is considered archived.

Director.title: Director
Director.description: Represents a director user with read-only access to school data.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Director entity (Firebase Auth UID).

prozilId.description: Public, user-friendly identifier for the director, in the format <name>-<6_digits>.

Invite.title: Invite
Invite.description: Represents an invitation for a user to join with a specific role.

Exercise.title: Exercise
Exercise.description: Represents a single reusable exercise created by a teacher for their exercise bank.

questionType.description: The type of interaction for the question.

text.description: The main text of the question. For fill_in_the_blank, use '___' for the blank space. For guess_the_word, this is the hint.

text2.description: Optional second part of the question text, for better organization.

librasText.description: Optional text content specifically for Libras characters.

options.description: Options for the question. For multiple_choice/fill_in_the_blank, there are 3 choices. For organize_syllables, these are the syllables to be organized (2-6). For memory_game, these are the items for the cards, in pairs. Not used for guess_the_word.

answer.description: The correct answer. For organize_syllables, this is the complete word. For guess_the_word, it's the word to be guessed. For memory_game, this field is not used.

categories.description: For 'organize_categories' questions, this holds the names of the categories.

categoryItems.description: For 'organize_categories' questions, this holds the items and their correct category.

Task.title: Task
Task.description: Represents a task assigned by a teacher, composed of one or more questions.

studentId.description: The Auth UID of the student to whom the task is assigned.

studentProzilId.description: The user-friendly ProZil ID of the student to whom the task is assigned. Denormalized for display.

studentName.description: The full name of the student to whom the task is assigned. Denormalized for display.

teacherName.description: The full name of the teacher who created the task. Denormalized for display.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the task was created.

completedAt.description: The timestamp when the student completed the task.

totalTime.description: Total time in seconds the student took to complete the task.

questions.description: A list of questions that make up the task, including student performance data.

attempts.description: Number of attempts the student made for this question.

status.description: The final status of the student's answer for this question.

timeTaken.description: Time in milliseconds to answer this question.

categories.description: For 'organize_categories' questions, this holds the names of the categories.

categoryItems.description: For 'organize_categories' questions, this holds the items and their correct category.

firestore.reasoning: The Firestore structure is designed to provide a clear separation between teacher and student data, ensuring efficient data access and security. The primary principle applied is Authorization Independence by avoiding `get()` calls in the security rules. This is achieved by structuring the data in a way that allows authorization to be determined based on the path and the user's authentication status, eliminating the need to fetch parent document data. The structure utilizes hierarchical paths to establish clear ownership for user-created content (Tasks, Exercises). For the QAPs requirement, the design segregates data based on ownership and role (teacher/student), thus filtering during list operations can be achieved securely using path-based rules. Tasks are organized under students, with a reference to the teacher who assigned them, enabling secure and efficient retrieval of tasks by students or teachers. Denormalization is used to include any necessary authorization data directly within the Task document (e.g., the studentId and the full question data).
